title: Setup team page: the members list's Title column reads 'USER_ID in TEAM_ID' beside the User column (server half of #30337)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb5R6JDdfyvtj3dPR2

Category: ① product defect with a named location. ⛔ Not a claim. This card is the `domain:server` half of #30337, item 2. The ui half of that card is PR #30417, which covers items 1 and 3. This half is filed across lanes to the server queue, as urgent p1 under the maintainer's cross-lane rule (10-30). Triage may regrade it.

**Business reason.** An administrator opens a team in Setup. The members tab lists each membership with a 标题 / Title column that reads `<user id> in <team id>`, two raw ids, next to the readable User column. The column tells nobody anything and looks broken. (#30337 measured this on main `04f36b63f8`.)

**Mechanism.** The #30337 executor measured this; it is in os-dev-report 6655783076, `out_of_scope_findings`.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-team-member.object.ts` declares `nameField: 'display_title'`.
- `display_title` is a formula, `record.user_id + ' in ' + record.team_id` (about line 138). It is evaluated before `$expand`, so it reads the two lookup ids, not their titles. The file's own comment says this.
- A related list with no authored columns leads with the declared nameField. That is `leadWithNameField` under ADR-0079, which exempts declared names. The highlightFields come after it.

**Suggested producer fix** (the executor's proposal; the owner decides):
- Declare `relatedListColumns: ['user_id', 'created_at']` on the `team_id` lookup.
- Declare `['team_id', 'created_at']` on the `user_id` lookup, for a user page's teams list.

Authored relationship columns are drawn verbatim, with no name lead. Another route is a record title that reads the related titles. That would be a wider change to how a formula title is computed.

**Expected.** A team page's members list shows the user, plus a useful second column such as when they joined. It shows no column of raw ids. The same holds for a user page's teams list.

**Reader.** `domain:server`, file `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-team-member.object.ts`, plus pins.

**Dedupe:** I searched `team member title raw id`, `sys_team_member display_title related list` and `relatedListColumns team_id`. Only #30337 matches.

Links: #30337, PR #30417, os-dev-report 6655783076.
